// LeetBuild: sync/atomic's generic Pointer[T] (go1_22_sync_atomic_type.go.txt), which the binary
// package's symbol table cannot carry. The interpreter registers this file under "sync/atomic", so
// atomic.Pointer resolves here while the package's other symbols (Int64, Bool, Value, LoadInt32, …)
// stay the native ones. The original swaps an unsafe.Pointer with LoadPointer/StorePointer; this
// one reads and writes a *T. Each method is still atomic where the runtime runs it: Go on
// GOARCH=wasm has one thread and no sysmon to preempt a goroutine, so goroutines switch only where
// one blocks, and nothing here blocks. The file imports nothing: an instantiated generic type
// resolves its body in its user's scope.

package atomic

// A Pointer is an atomic pointer of type *T. The zero value is a nil *T.
type Pointer[T any] struct {
	// Mention *T in a field to disallow conversion between Pointer types.
	_ [0]*T

	v *T
}

// Load atomically loads and returns the value stored in x.
func (x *Pointer[T]) Load() *T { return x.v }

// Store atomically stores val into x.
func (x *Pointer[T]) Store(val *T) { x.v = val }

// Swap atomically stores new into x and returns the previous value.
func (x *Pointer[T]) Swap(new *T) (old *T) {
	old, x.v = x.v, new
	return old
}

// CompareAndSwap executes the compare-and-swap operation for x.
func (x *Pointer[T]) CompareAndSwap(old, new *T) (swapped bool) {
	if x.v != old {
		return false
	}
	x.v = new
	return true
}
